_doc: Missions. map = citymap.js options (seed + district). waves: at (s after drop), kind, count, from ('edge' = the district's road ends, 'nest', or {x,z}), spread, every (repeat), until, elite (chance). objectives: kill / killAll / destroy (lots by index into the generated map's biggest lots of a recipe: pickLots) / survive / reach. optional objectives raise the grade. par.time = the time an A-grade run takes. pay = base pay. tier = loot tier (1 early … 5 late). length = 'short' 4-8 min | 'mid' 8-15 | 'long' 15+. comms = lines said in-world (who + text + when). night = time of day, 0 noon … 1 deep night.

missions.name: Drop Zone
missions.brief: The swarm has broken into the Glasswell business district. Drop in, clear the streets, get out.

comms.text: Frame, you're over Glasswell. Doors open in three. Swarm's thick on the east avenues.
Fuel depots on your map will go up if you hit them. Use that.
Big contacts moving in. Armoured fronts — get round behind them.
Dropship's on the pad, north-east corner. Come home.

missions.name: Fuel Line
missions.brief: A rival company is pumping our refineries dry. Burn their three tank farms before the convoy leaves.

comms.text: Three refineries, marked on your map. They're full. Stand well back when they blow.
They've brought rocket artillery. Watch the ground for the red circles.
Smoke's visible from orbit. Nice work. Pick-up's at the north-east lot.

missions.name: Hold the Line
missions.brief: Evacuation trains are leaving the Kettle Row station. Keep the swarm off it until the last one is out.

objectives.label: Hold until the last train leaves

comms.text: Nine minutes, Frame. The trains don't stop for anything.
Swollen ones coming in. Don't let them reach you — pop them at range.
Ground's moving under the station. Something's digging.
Last train's boarding. This is everything they've got.

missions.name: Cold Cargo
missions.brief: Halden-Voss is trucking the Saltmarsh cold stores out of the city — food the shelters need. Stop the haulers before they reach the coast road.

comms.text: Six haulers, one road out. They won't stop to fight you — they just want the coast road.
First truck's rolling. The escort will try to keep you busy. Don't let it.
Tank on the dock road. Its front plate's thick; get round it.
Cold stores are staying put. Nice. I'm on the north pad.

missions.name: Dead Air
missions.brief: Spindle Quarter is contested: swarm in the streets, Halden-Voss relay masts on the roofs jamming every channel we have. Plant charges on the masts and give the city its voice back.

objectives.label: Plant charges on the relay masts (4)

comms.text: Four masts, marked. Stand on each one until the charge is set. Moving off it loses you time.
Jammer walker inbound. Your locks will drop near it — kill it with your guns.
Red line on your screen means a sniper has you. Break line of sight.
I can hear you clearly for the first time all week. Pad's north-east.

missions.name: Last Bus Out
missions.brief: Four haulers full of Ashgrove families are crossing the district to the evacuation line. The swarm can smell them. Get at least three through.

comms.text: Haulers are lined up at the south gate. They'll go when you're down.
Convoy's moving. When the swarm piles on a truck it slows to a crawl — clear the road ahead of it.
Bloaters. Pop them away from the trucks.
That's the whole nest coming. Stay on the trucks.
Families are over the line. Come home, Frame.

missions.name: Long Fall
missions.brief: No dropship can get near Thornfield — the air's thick with spore and anti-air. We're dropping you from orbit. Steer your fall, land on something that matters, and burn the great hives.

comms.text: You're falling. Steer with your move stick — land near a hive and the impact does half the work.
Down! Hives are marked. They bud swarm while they stand.
Ground's moving — burrowers. Keep your feet light.
Spore count's falling. I can get in now. North pad.

missions.name: Brood Queen
missions.brief: Something huge is laying eggs under the Crown. The swarm keeps coming back to it. Find it and put it down.

comms.text: You're over the Crown. Ground sensors are jumping — something heavy under the plaza. Stay mobile.
There she is. That's the mother of the lot. Those glowing sacs on her flanks are where the swarmers come from — burst them.
One sac down. The brood's thinning on that side.
Claw's off. She's dragging that side now.
Took her other claw. She'll have to spit at you instead.
Both sacs gone — her head plate's loose. Hit the glowing spot on her head.
She's angry. Watch for a red lane on the ground — that's her charging line. Get off it.
Seeing acid going up from her back. Circles on the ground, frame — don't stand in them.
She's down. Nothing's spawning. Take a breath, then grab what you can.
Pad's lit. Bring that chitin home — the workshop's going to want it.

missions.name: Sawtooth
missions.brief: Halden-Voss has sent one of its named pilots into Foundry Flats to hunt freelancers. Draw her out and beat her.

comms.text: Foundry Flats. Halden-Voss troopers on the ground — and they've brought someone special.
That's their ace. She fights like you do: boosts, dodges, runs hot. Make her burn her energy, then punish her.
She's out. Halden-Voss will remember that name — yours.
Dropship inbound. North-east lot.
